summary: Phase 1 of issue #345 (forge provider-abstraction seam + detection, GitHub-only, zero behavior change) is fully implemented and matches the saved plan. ForgeKind literal added to db/enums.py; new common/forge.py supplies the runtime_checkable structural ForgeClient Protocol (10 methods mirroring GitHubClient), make_forge_client/ensure_forge_supported/concrete_forge/detect_forge_from_url, and ForgeNotSupportedError carrying FORGE_NOT_SUPPORTED with the exact honest BitBucket message. RepoRef is forge-aware (forge field, host detection in from_url for github/bitbucket/bare-slug/unknown-ValueError, host-aware https_url/ssh_url/clone_url_like). WorkspaceProfile.forge (default auto) plus resolver repo_url threading implement precedence explicit > URL host > github and persist resolved_profile.forge once. Both construction sites (worker.py _pr_monitor_factory, monitor_handoff.py) build gh via make_forge_client(concrete_forge(...)); consumer type hints swapped to ForgeClient (GitHubClientError left untouched per plan); execution_flow.py adds an early FORGE_NOT_SUPPORTED gate before dispatch/agent/push/gh pr create. Reason catalog and openapi.json regenerated. Four test modules cover every planned case (factory/protocol/detection, RepoRef parsing+builders, resolver precedence+round-trip, executor gate parametrized over feature_branch_pr and sync_release_pr). VALIDATION.md records focused suites green plus ruff/format/mypy clean and catalog/openapi drift gates satisfied; broad pytest+coverage is AWF/CI-owned per the workspace contract.
